prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with 3000+ calorie daily intake and balanced macronutrient distribution for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with macronutrient ratios appropriate for endurance athletes (55-60% carbs, 15-20% protein, 20-25% fat)
Includes meals/snacks strategically timed around training sessions for optimal energy and recovery
Presented as a compact, concise single-day format with clear meal timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3000+ calories with specific macronutrient ratios and timing around training sessions
